newsitem.title: USA: Kelley Oil & Gas ups offer for notes.
newsitem.headline: Kelley Oil & Gas ups offer for notes.

text.p: Kelley Oil & Gas Corp said Tuesday it has amended its September 24 for its outstanding $100 million issue of 13-1/2 percent senior notes increasing the offer price to $1,110 per $1,000 principal amount (plus accrued and unpaid interest) from $1,110.
The expiration date for the offer remains unchanged at 2400 EDT October 22/0400 GMT October 23.
The company also said the consents needed to eliminate the notes' restrictive covenants have been received.

Notwithstanding the receipt of requisite consents, Kelley Oil said. it is extending the deadline for holders of notes to consent to the indenture changes for to 1700 EDT/2100 GMT October 9 from 2400 EDT October 7/0400 GMT October 8.
Holders who consent and tender their notes by the deadline will still receive an additional $30 per $1,000 principal amount of consenting notes, the company said.
No other term or condition of the September 24 offer and solicitation has been amended, Kelley Oil said.
The dealer managers for the transaction are Morgan Stanley & Co Inc, Chase Securities Inc and Lazard Freres & Co LLC.
